2026-11-10 owner delegation (Daniel, project thread): best-practice calls are Claude's. Decision: the public route-family audit is re-run on production by a Remote Control session on the owner's machine (cloud cannot reach frequencylocal.com). The row stays open for signed-in, admin and security-boundary coverage, which this script does not reach.

2026-11-10 signed-in and admin pass (82 routes: 35 member, 47 admin) in the owner's own signed-in Chrome, read-only, production build of main. COVERAGE GAPS: 1536px only (the window cannot be resized through the extension, so 390 and 1920 are not covered); DOM checks, not axe (the page CSP blocks injecting axe); dynamic [id] and [slug] routes out of scope. Findings fixed: /on-air had no h1 (an sr-only h1 now names it); /admin/entry-points had duplicate svg id qrlogoclip (clip and mask ids are now keyed by the encoded text); /admin/listing-seeder photo input had no accessible name; /admin/elements previews render live hero components with their own h1 (the sample is now inert, the DOM still holds the h1s). Not defects: /connections, /people, /profile and /marketplace are redirects whose landing pages each have one h1; /events briefly shows two h1s while streaming. /admin/qr threw React #441 only under a local production build without UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET (lib/qr/node-code.ts refuses to sign); confirm that secret is set in Vercel production. Open: /admin/qr page title is the generic site title; csp.violation script-src eval reported on /people/<handle> and /create-a-space.

2026-11-16 production header and metadata sweep (read-only, no browser). What: one GET per route against https://frequencylocal.com through the Vercel fetch tool (server HTML and response headers only, no JavaScript, redirects followed), for the 22 DEFAULT_ROUTES in scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs plus /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt and /llms.txt, between 16:02 and 16:06 UTC. Production changed deployment twice during the sweep (dpl_DTPt..., then dpl_6ESoz..., then dpl_FTy8...), so cache readings are first-hit readings on a fresh deployment. Numbers: 25 of 25 returned 200, 25 of 25 carried the Content-Security-Policy header, no error text in any body (searched for Application error, Internal Server Error, the not-found copy and BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT). 18 of the 22 page routes answer under their own path; 4 are redirects, so the audit list visits 4 pages twice: /what-is-frequency lands on /about, /tools-for-community-builders lands on /how-to-build-community, /stories lands on /the-community (the parked 302 in next.config.ts) and /start lands on /join. Of the 18 own-path pages, 15 are prerendered and edge cached (x-nextjs-prerender 1, x-vercel-cache PRERENDER on the first hit and HIT with a rising age on repeats, cache-control public, max-age=0, must-revalidate): /, /pricing, /features, /about, /themes, /the-community, /loneliness, /friendship-as-an-adult, /how-to-start-a-circle, /how-to-build-community, /how-to-be-more-social, /discover, /guidelines, /privacy, /accessibility. 3 are rendered per request (x-vercel-cache MISS, cache-control private, no-cache, no-store): /create-a-space (declares force-dynamic), /events and /sign-in; /join, where /start lands, is the same. Every one of the 18 has exactly one title and a meta description. 17 have a canonical link that names their own URL and robots index, follow; /sign-in has no canonical and is noindex, nofollow, and /join has no canonical and is noindex, follow, both by design. 17 have one h1 in the server HTML; /create-a-space has its h1 twice in the raw HTML (once in a Suspense fallback and once in the streamed segment that replaces it), which is one h1 after the stream completes but two for a reader that does not run JavaScript. /sitemap.xml: 200, application/xml, 646 URLs, no duplicates, every URL on https://frequencylocal.com, none of the four redirecting paths or /sign-in or /join listed; MISS on the first hit and HIT (age 124) two minutes later. /robots.txt: 200, text/plain, names the sitemap, MISS on its one fetch. /llms.txt: 200, text/plain, PRERENDER, cache-control public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400. To file, not fixed here: (1) DEFAULT_ROUTES still lists the four redirecting paths, so each audit run spends 8 of its 44 page visits on duplicates and reports them under the wrong name; (2) /create-a-space is the only marketing page in the list that is never cached, which is deliberate today (force-dynamic for the ?new= resume) and worth a ruling because it is the paid-funnel entry; (3) the duplicate h1 in the raw /create-a-space HTML. What remains: this sweep cannot see redirect status codes (the tool follows them), rendered layout, console errors, contrast or anything behind sign-in; the route-family browser run on production and the signed-in, admin and security-boundary coverage are still owed. Row stays OPEN.
